Three.js r164
-------------
Files: three.module.js, SkeletonUtils.js
License: three.LICENSE (MIT, Copyright 2010-2024 three.js authors)
Sources:
  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r164
  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r164/LICENSE
  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r164/examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js
Local modification: SkeletonUtils.js imports ./three.module.js so the bundled
modules can load from the flat vendor directory.

Ammo.js / Bullet Physics
------------------------
Files: ammo.wasm.js, ammo.wasm.wasm
Licenses: ammo.LICENSE contains the Ammo.js and Bullet zlib notices, the
Ammo.js author notice, and upstream Emscripten/musl runtime notices.
Distributed build sources:
  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r164/examples/jsm/libs/ammo.wasm.js
  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r164/examples/jsm/libs/ammo.wasm.wasm
Upstream project: https://github.com/kripken/ammo.js
The WASM binary matches the Three.js r164 distribution. The JavaScript matches
that distribution before the local wrapper, apart from trailing whitespace.
Local modification: the ES module wrapper invokes Ammo.call({}, options) and
exports the resulting loader as the default export. The existing source marks
this wrapper as local.

Upstream license declaration:
  SEE LICENSE IN https://www.photonengine.com/terms
Local modification: the Node-only ws adapter/footer is replaced with the
browser's native WebSocket and a default ES module export. The npm ws package
is not bundled in this directory.
The included $jscomp helpers come from Closure Compiler; their Apache 2.0
license and attribution are also recorded in photon.LICENSE.

License sources were checked against the upstream projects and the published
Photon 4.4.0 package on 2026-11-11.
